summary: Iteration 13 dark/light theme system verified end-to-end. Desktop defaults DARK, Mobile defaults LIGHT (verified via CDP setDeviceMetricsOverride mobile:true). Toggle persists to localStorage 'imk-theme'. Logo swaps correctly between imk-logo-white.png (dark) and imk-logo-dark.png (light). Contact form full submit works in LIGHT with backend persistence (potential_venture_opportunity=true confirmed via GET /api/enquiries for Strategic Partnership + Investor/VC). Dropdown selects render white bg + dark text in LIGHT. Sonner toast readable in LIGHT. DARK regression: all 8 sections present, canvas working, red accent #e60000 = rgb(230,0,0) preserved in both themes. Zero console errors across all flows. Backend 15/15 pytest passing (unchanged).

design_issues.screen: LIGHT mode - hero area small tracked labels
issues: Tracked/mono overline labels like 'IMKINDO // APPLIED INTELLIGENCE', 'EST. EXPERIENCE', 'VENTURES LIVE', 'OUTCOME', '04 // OUR VENTURES', 'INVESTORS/ENTERPRISE/INDUSTRIES/TECHNOLOGY' render slightly faint on light background. Still legible but noticeably less punchy than in dark mode where they were designed. Consider bumping these to a darker mid-grey in html.light overrides (rgb(70,70,70) or similar) for better hierarchy. Non-blocking — text passes minimum WCAG AA at current contrast.
The centred radial spotlight gradient that creates atmosphere in DARK mode produces a subtly awkward brighter 'blob' in LIGHT. Cosmetic only, hero still functional and beautiful.

verified_form_flow_light.submit_success_block: Thank you for contacting Imkindo — success block displayed

action_items: OPTIONAL/POLISH: In /app/frontend/src/index.css html.light overrides, consider promoting the tracked/mono overline labels (currently very faded whites in dark mode) to a darker grey e.g. rgb(70,70,70) so hierarchy matches dark-mode punch. Non-blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: ThemeContext detectDefault correctly uses (max-width: 768px) matchMedia for mobile detection and falls back to dark for SSR — clean implementation.
NetworkCanvas uses themeRef.current inside the RAF loop instead of restarting the effect on theme change — good performance choice, colours adapt live without teardown.

ThemeToggle has data-testid='theme-toggle' appearing twice in DOM (one in hidden md:flex desktop nav, one in visible mobile row). Playwright locator resolves 2 nodes on mobile viewport — tests must select the visible one (`.locator(...).last` or `:visible`). Not a bug, but tests using bare selector will hit the hidden desktop instance. Consider adding distinct testids like 'theme-toggle-desktop' / 'theme-toggle-mobile' for cleaner automation.
Logo triggers a network request on every theme switch (browser will cache). Both PNGs load with transparent bg — verified.

success_rate.frontend: 100% functional; 2 minor cosmetic light-mode design nits

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 13 theme system passes all acceptance criteria. Use CDP Emulation.setDeviceMetricsOverride (NOT playwright set_viewport_size) for viewport tests. For mobile use mobile:true, deviceScaleFactor:2. Theme is stored at window.localStorage['imk-theme']; class applied to document.documentElement as 'light' or 'dark'. Two theme-toggle testids exist in DOM (desktop + mobile) — use :visible or .last in playwright. Backend unchanged since iter10, still 15/15 passing. To re-test form submission in LIGHT: forcelocalStorage 'light', reload, scroll to [data-testid=contact-section], fill form fields (enquiry-name-input, enquiry-company-input, enquiry-position-input, enquiry-email-input, enquiry-phone-input, enquiry-country-input, enquiry-interested-select, enquiry-orgtype-select, enquiry-message-input), click enquiry-submit-button, wait 2.5s for [data-testid=enquiry-success].
